implementation: students completing the course in 2026 or beyond
objectives: Use music elements and concepts in composition.
Analyse music elements and concepts, and compositional devices.
Apply literacy skills to communicate ideas.
Interpret music elements and concepts in performance.
Evaluate music elements and concepts, and compositional devices.

units.title: Designs
units.inquiry_question: How does the treatment and combination of different music elements enable musicians to design music that communicates meaning through performance and composition?
units.description: Students explore how the treatment and combination of music elements and concepts enables musicians to design music that communicates meaning through performance and composition, developing technical performance skills and using music elements and concepts in composition.

units.title: Identities
units.inquiry_question: How do musicians use their understanding of music elements, concepts and practices to communicate cultural, political, social and personal identities when performing, composing and responding to music?
units.description: Students make and respond to music that expresses cultural, political and social identities in both local and global contexts. Students consolidate their knowledge from Unit 1 and continue to develop their understanding of music elements and concepts, and compositional devices as they consider, develop and refine their own emerging voice or style as a musician.

units.title: Innovations
units.inquiry_question: How do musicians incorporate innovative music practices to communicate meaning when performing, composing and responding to music?
units.description: Students explore how musicians incorporate innovative music practices to communicate meaning. Students use music elements and concepts innovatively in composition, demonstrate technical skills in performance specific to the instrument or sound source, and realise music to an audience.

units.title: Narratives
units.inquiry_question: How do musicians manipulate music elements to communicate narrative when performing, composing and responding to music?
units.description: Students explore how musicians manipulate music elements to communicate narrative, including in film music, television music, game music, musical theatre, opera, program music or art song.

internal_assessment.title: Performance
internal_assessment.description: Internal assessment 1: Performance (20%) — assesses learning in Unit 3; total marks 20

internal_assessment.title: Composition
internal_assessment.description: Internal assessment 2: Composition (20%) — assesses learning in Unit 3; total marks 20

internal_assessment.title: Project (musicology and composition, or musicology and performance)
internal_assessment.description: Internal assessment 3: Project (35%) — assesses learning in Unit 4; two response options: musicology and composition, or musicology and performance; total marks 35

external_assessment.title: Examination — extended response
external_assessment.description: External assessment: Examination — extended response (25%) — developed and marked by the QCAA, common to all schools
